question: Under Section 118 of the Bharatiya Nyay Sanhita 2023, how many categories of 'grievous hurt' are enumerated, and which of the following is one of those categories?

answers.text: 8 categories; including any hurt which endangers life or causes the sufferer to be in severe bodily pain for 20 days or more.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. BNS Section 118 defines exactly 8 categories of grievous hurt. The 8th — often called the 'catch-all' category — is 'any hurt which endangers life or causes the sufferer to be in severe bodily pain or unable to follow his ordinary pursuits for 20 days or more.' This category is the most commonly invoked in serious assault cases.

answers.text: 6 categories; including any permanent disfiguration of the face or head.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. BNS Section 118 specifies 8 categories, not 6. Permanent disfiguration of the face or head IS one of the 8 categories, but the total number stated here is wrong.

answers.text: 10 categories; including any fracture or dislocation of a bone or tooth.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. The number is 8, not 10. Fracture or dislocation of a bone or tooth is category 7 of the 8 categories in BNS Section 118.

answers.text: 8 categories; including any hurt that results in a hospital admission of more than 48 hours.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect on the criterion. The number (8) is correct, but 'hospital admission > 48 hours' is not a statutory criterion in BNS Section 118. The relevant duration threshold in the 8th category is inability to follow ordinary pursuits or severe bodily pain for 20 days or more.

overallFeedback.feedback: BNS Section 118 = exactly 8 categories of grievous hurt. The categories include: emasculation, permanent eye/ear damage, permanent disfigurement of head/face, loss/permanent impairment of a limb/joint, permanent impairment of an organ, fracture/dislocation of bone or tooth, and (8th) hurt endangering life or causing 20-day incapacity.
Good. Fix 8 in memory: BNS Section 118 = 8 categories of grievous hurt. The 8th (endangers life / 20-day incapacity) is the most commonly applied in clinical medicolegal work.
